profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Backend dev with some frontend/mobile experience, living in South Bay

C#, Java, Javascript, Groovy, Python, C, C++, 
AWS, Guice, Protobuffer, DynamoDb, Redis, Node, MongoDB
Scalable cloud architecture
Project Management/Scrum Master
Infrastructure cost analysis and optimization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and maintained backend services for Nest and Google Home

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
Developed and owned features for Amazon Astro.
Worked as team scrum-master to manage tasks and plan future work
Lead investigations into complex, multi-team product bugs

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description: Designed and maintained cloud game features for server-authoritative mobile games.

positions.description:
Designed and maintained scalable, always-on web backend services for online video games. 
Launched game - Alliance: Heroes of the Spire

positions.description: Internship for Microsoft's XBOX division on the media DRM team.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern in Test
positions.description: Worked for Microsoft's online services division (bing), on their social network team. Learned about the development processes of a world class tech company.

positions.title: Tutor/Grader
positions.description:
As a Tutor and Grader for Computer Science (CMPS) - 20, Introduction to Computer Game Programing:
-Worked with students to teach C# and MS-XNA Game Framework
-Graded student work
-Collaborated with other tutors, TAs, and Professor to plan and execute curriculum
-Lectured to class on GNU-Blender

projects.title: Global Game Jam
projects.description: Four-time participant in the Global Game Jam. Designed and programmed games with small teams in very short periods of time.
